# Gabe Hassan

> Gabe Hassan (Gabriel Hassan) is a computer science student at the University of Michigan, class of 2028, and the founder of JustMonitors. He builds AI agents, monitors, API clients, and web tools in Python, JavaScript, and Go.

He lives in Ann Arbor, Michigan. Contact: me@gabehassan.com. He goes by Gabe; his site is gabehassan.com and his GitHub is github.com/gabehassan.

## Education

- University of Michigan, Ann Arbor: B.S. in Computer Science, expected May 2028. Coursework in data structures and algorithms and discrete math. Involved in the Michigan AI Safety Initiative (MAISI) and MHacks 2026 (hackathon).

## Skills

- Languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, C, C++, SQL, HTML/CSS
- Frameworks: FastAPI, Node.js, Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, NumPy, pandas, Pydantic, pytest
- Infrastructure: Docker, PostgreSQL, AWS EC2, Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare R2, Vercel, Linux
- AI: LLM agents, tool calling, structured outputs, OpenAI API, Claude Code, Codex

## Experience

- [JustMonitors](https://gabehassan.com/justmonitors): founder (2020 to 2022). Paid Discord alerts for sneaker resellers, built on a Node.js Twitter monitor he wrote: OAuth 1.0a request signing, a pool of eleven API keys, a role-gated Discord bot for staff, AWS EC2. 80 individual monthly users and 6 paying Discord groups (100+ members combined), who bought $50,000+ in products through its alerts. He ran a team of five (two developers, three support) and wrote the docs.
- Independent resale business (2017 to present): $100,000+ in sneakers and computer hardware sold on StockX, GOAT, Grailed, and private marketplaces, with his own Node.js checkout tool.

## Projects

- taste: an AI agent people text on iMessage. It saves the links, screenshots, and books they send, replies with the gist, and learns their taste. Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Next.js, and OpenAI tool calling.
- Fantasy football simulator: a Monte Carlo simulator in Python, NumPy, and C that picks lineups by win probability. It beat ESPN's picks in 80%+ of weeks, and on the unseen 2025 season its 80% score ranges caught the real score in 79.7% of 4,800 matchups.
- [Watchlist Match](https://gabehassan.com/watchlist-match): compares friends' Letterboxd watchlists, sorts the shared films by rating, and picks one with a slot machine. Vercel serverless functions scrape and cache Letterboxd pages; proof-of-work, Turnstile, and signed tokens keep it from being abused. 300+ visitors in 20+ countries. Live at https://watchlistmatch.com.
- [Event photo booth](https://gabehassan.com/photo-booth): a browser photo booth for student events at the University of Michigan. Guests scan a QR code, shoot on their phones, and their photos appear on the projector wall within 3 seconds; 50+ guests have used it. Cloudflare Workers and R2, no database.
- [Squarespace Checkout Client](https://gabehassan.com/squarespace-checkout): a headless client that completes a Squarespace order in seven HTTP requests and 2 to 5 seconds.
- table42 and noresi: Go clients that book Resy and OpenTable reservations through their undocumented APIs in 200ms end to end, where open source tools take about 2.5 seconds.
